options.name: host
options.description: Specifies the DNS host name or address for connecting to the remote device over the specified transport.  The value of host is used as the destination address for the transport.

options.name: kvm_num_cd
options.description: Select the number of Remote KVM CD/DVD devices that support for virtual Media redirection, The max support number of html5 KVM is 2 and java KVM is 4.

options.name: kvm_num_fd
options.description: Select the number of Remote KVM floppy devices that support for Virtual Media redirection.

options.name: kvm_num_hd
options.description: Select the number of Remote KVM Hard disk devices to support for Virtual Media redirection.

options.name: num_cd
options.description: Select the number of CD/DVD devices that support for Virtual Media redirection.

options.name: num_fd
options.description: Select the number of floppy devices that support for Virtual Media redirection.

options.name: num_hd
options.description: Select the number of harddisk devices that support for Virtual Media redirection.

options.name: password
options.description: Specifies the password to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: power_save_mode
options.description: Check this option to enable Power Save Mode in BMC.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: sd_media
options.description: Check this option to enable SD Media support in BMC.

options.name: secure_channel
options.description: Check this option to enable encrypt media recirection packets.

options.name: username
options.description: Configures the username to use to authenticate the connection to the remote device. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable C(ANSIBLE_NET_USERNAME) will be used instead.
